title: Nutty Spanish Pappardelle Pisto Manchego
description: Earthy and snappy Spanish dish featuring pappardelle pasta, broil, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, cooked in a tandoor clay pot, similar to a pisto manchego
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large tandoor clay pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chopped zucchini and bell pepper, cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato and cook until the mixture is heated through.
Stir in the chopped almonds and smoked paprika.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the clay pot, tossing to combine with the vegetable mixture.
Top the pasta with crumbled manchego cheese and place under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
